notes.title: The Spooktacular Autumn Update
notes.content:
[p]🩺🎃 [b]Introducing: The Spooktacular Autumn Update — Halloween Comes to the Clinic![/b] 🎃🩺[/p][p align="start"]Fog rolls in around the entrance, lights flicker like a critical ECG, and the air smells oddly of pumpkin latte… and antiseptic? That’s right — [b]Halloween is arriving at your clinic[/b], and this time, it’s here not for souls… but for a full check-up![/p][p align="start"]🧙‍♀️ [b]Our heroes — in festive costumes and lab coats![/b]
The adorable little witch is now the [b]Chief Therapist for Magical Ailments[/b], and the stylish vampire has become the new [b]Hematologist[/b] ([i]he takes blood tests very seriously[/i]).
They’re already on duty, ready to diagnose patients, prescribe healing potions, and perform “soul-teleportation surgeries” — all strictly by schedule and in full compliance with hygiene regulations![/p][p align="start"]🧬 [b]Limited-Time Collections — Only Once a Year![/b]
To celebrate the season, we’re launching [b]exclusive seasonal sets[/b] available [b]only during Halloween[/b].
These items will [b]never return in this form again[/b] — collect them before the final night of the festival![/p][p align="start"]🔧 [b]Improved Difficulty — Healing Just Got Smoother![/b]
Based on your feedback, we’ve performed a [b]full gameplay balance resuscitation[/b] and adjusted several challenging levels.[/p][p align="start"]✨ [b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]🩻 [b]The celebration starts soon — jump into the game now![/b]
With medically precise care,
[b]The Development Team[/b] 🩺👻[/p]
